title: Converge chat decomposition with trust-boundary protections
description:
Problem: chat module complexity and trust-sensitive behavior are tightly coupled in one large service, increasing regression and security risk.

Desired outcome: decompose chat architecture while preserving role-based controls, tool-call bounds, and write-approval semantics.

Scope:
- In scope: extract chat provider/orchestration/write proposal components with invariant checks from TSK-0048.
- Out of scope: chat feature expansion.

Acceptance criteria:
- Chat service concerns are split into bounded modules.
- Authorization and write approval behavior remains unchanged under tests.
- Tool-call bounds and safe-context behavior are preserved.

Validation:
- Run targeted chat, pages/chat, and security tests covering proposal and approval flows.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Convergence task created to combine chat hotspot decomposition with explicit trust-boundary preservation.
